content: The Anjām compares Sufism with the science of letters: an introduction on the importance of knowledge and two sections (vaṣl), on the science of Sufism and its objectives and on the science of letters and its objectives; an epilogue gives three accounts in support of lettrism, two from the Imams and one on the sura-initial letters (muqaṭṭaʿāt) as containing predictive knowledge, especially of political events; section two refers the reader to the K. al-Mafāḥiṣ.
